recent.text: The Seahawks are 2.5 games behind the 49ers in the NFC West and a game behind Green Bay for the third wild-card. ESPN Analytics gives them a 4.3% chance to win the division and a 46.9% chance to make the playoffs. It rates their remaining strength of schedule as fourth-hardest.
